I ship real products,
not just prototypes.

I'm Murtaz Tahir — a solo developer from Pakistan building AI-powered SaaS products for US and UK clients. I turn complex ideas into production-ready platforms that actually generate revenue.

Most recently I built Salevrix AI — a complete Apollo.io alternative with 10 AI agents, 15 automations, Firebase auth, Supabase DB, and Resend email — entirely solo, in 6 months. That's my proof of work.

I don't just write code. I think like a founder — obsessing over UX, conversion, SEO, and scalability. When I build your product, I build it like it's mine.

Hi! I'm Murtaz's AI assistant. Ask me anything about his skills, projects, pricing, or how to work with him! 👋

How fast can you deliver?
+
Most projects delivered in 2-4 weeks. Simple AI integrations: 1-2 weeks. Full SaaS platforms: 4-8 weeks. Exact timeline in the proposal.
What's your payment structure?
+
50% upfront, 50% on delivery. For larger projects (+$10K): 40% start, 30% mid-point, 30% delivery. Bank transfer or Wise only.
Do you work with non-technical founders?
+
Yes — most clients are non-technical. I handle everything: architecture, development, deployment, documentation. You just need to know what problem you're solving.
Can I see your previous work?
+
Yes! Salevrix AI is live at salevrix-ai-black.vercel.app — fully built by me solo. 10 AI agents, 15 automations, full auth + dashboard + email system.
What if I'm not happy with the result?
+
Revisions included until you're satisfied — within original scope. 2 weeks post-launch support always included at no extra cost.

// how I work

My Process

01
Discovery Call
30-minute call. You tell me what you're building, I ask the right questions, we figure out if I'm the right fit. No pitch, no pressure.
// Day 0 — Free
02
Proposal & Scope
Detailed proposal: exactly what I'll build, in what order, by when, and for how much. Fixed price — no surprise invoices mid-project.
// 24-48 hours
03
Build Phase
I build fast and share progress daily via a live Vercel preview URL. Feedback incorporated immediately. No waiting weeks to see progress.
// Week 1-3
04
Review & Polish
Full QA, performance optimization, mobile testing, and final tweaks. Production-ready before handover — no half-baked delivery.
// Week 3-4
05
Launch & Handover
Deploy to production, full codebase + documentation handover, 2 weeks post-launch support at no extra cost.
// Week 4 — Ongoing support available
